chunks: Whatever is in it from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhkhas, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhkhas.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author narrates
key_terms.رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى النَّخَّاسِ: the named transmitter from whom these reports are narrated

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhkhas in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhkhas in this book. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is central to hadith preservation and source authentication in Shia hadith literature.
